cards.title: HASH SLINGER
cards.concept: grinning bareheaded street-stall cook with his short swept-up hair showing, in a grey utility jacket and a stained apron, flipping a sizzling hash brown on a spatula held up by his chest, one tiny cyan LED on his earpiece
cards.hook: Blockchains run on hashes, and this passionate chain builder serves them up hot.

cards.title: GAS PUMP ATTENDANT
cards.concept: cheerful bareheaded pump attendant with his short swept-up hair showing, in grey coveralls with a name patch, holding a chunky fuel nozzle and hose across his chest, a cheap wrist display with one tiny cyan LED
cards.hook: Every on-chain transaction pays gas, and the blockchain integrator fills the tank with a big grin.

cards.title: RACK TECH
cards.concept: upbeat bareheaded data-centre technician with his short swept-up hair showing, in a worn grey work jacket with a lanyard badge, a coil of grey patch cable looped over one shoulder and a crimp tool in his hand
cards.hook: Compute Labs lives in the data centre, and its founding engineer knows every cable in the rack.

cards.title: BUG EXTERMINATOR
cards.concept: confident bareheaded exterminator with his short swept-up hair showing, in grey coveralls with a respirator hanging at his neck, a small spray tank on his back and the spray wand held up at his chest
cards.hook: A full-stack developer hunts bugs on every floor, from the front end to the chain.

cards.title: NIGHT SHIFT DEV
cards.concept: beaming bareheaded coder with his short swept-up hair showing, in a grey hoodie under a dark utility vest, raising a steaming synth-coffee cup at his chest, a cheap earpiece blinking one tiny cyan LED
cards.hook: Founding-engineer energy: still shipping the next build while the neon city sleeps.

cards.title: NETRUNNER
cards.concept: focused bareheaded netrunner with his short swept-up hair showing and a sly grin, in dark techwear with green terminal-code trim, a slim cyberdeck held at his chest and a thin data cable running from a small temple jack
cards.hook: Full-stack developer: he jacks into every layer from the interface down to the chain.

cards.title: DRONE JOCKEY
cards.concept: grinning bareheaded drone jockey with his short swept-up hair showing, in a padded grey flight jacket with green piping, a small quad drone with green running lights and cyan rotors hovering beside his shoulder, a slim controller on his wrist
cards.hook: Blockchain integration for applications at scale: his drone relays every transaction from app to chain.

cards.title: API PLUMBER
cards.concept: cheerful bareheaded pipe fitter with his short swept-up hair showing, in navy coveralls with green hazard stripes, a big wrench on his shoulder and a loop of glowing green conduit pipe held across his chest, a small implant on the back of his hand
cards.hook: Blockchain integration is plumbing, and he pipes applications straight into the chain.

cards.title: BLOCK PARTY DJ
cards.concept: ecstatic bareheaded club DJ with his short swept-up hair showing and his widest grin, headphones hanging around his neck, in a dark bomber jacket with green trim, a small green-lit mixer deck at his chest and a tall speaker stack behind one shoulder
cards.hook: His upbeat builder energy turns every new block into a party.

cards.title: ONCHAIN RONIN
cards.concept: cool bareheaded street samurai with his short swept-up hair showing and a confident grin, in a sleek armoured high-collared jacket with glowing teal seams and one shoulder guard, a faintly glowing cyan holo-katana resting over his shoulder
cards.hook: A passion for building with blockchain: a blade who fights only on-chain.

cards.title: GPU BRAWLER
cards.concept: bold bareheaded brawler with his short swept-up hair showing and a fierce happy grin, in a teal-seamed armoured vest, his fist raised at his chest inside a heavy gauntlet built from a graphics card whose fans glow faint cyan
cards.hook: Compute Labs turns GPUs into on-chain assets, and its founding engineer wears one to punch above his weight.

cards.title: ORACLE FIXER
cards.concept: smooth bareheaded fixer with his short swept-up hair showing and a knowing grin, in a long dark coat with glowing teal seams and a turned-up collar, holding a glowing cyan data spike between two fingers at his chest
cards.hook: Oracles bring real-world data on-chain, just as Compute Labs brings real GPUs on-chain, and the blockchain integrator wires up the link.

cards.title: CHROME ARCHITECT
cards.concept: commanding bareheaded architect with his short swept-up hair showing and a big grin, in ornate chrome shoulder plates with violet seams, one chrome forearm raised, a tall violet holographic wireframe tower of stacked layers glowing behind one shoulder with hot-pink light on the costume
cards.hook: A full-stack developer building at scale designs the whole tower, from base layer to top floor.

cards.title: VALIDATOR PRIME
cards.concept: radiant bareheaded chrome-augmented validator with his short swept-up hair showing and a triumphant grin, in chrome chest armour with magenta neon seams, a wide violet holographic hexagon-cell shield rising behind his shoulders and a hot-pink seal glowing in his raised chrome palm
cards.hook: Blockchain passion turned into armour: the validator who signs off on every block.

cards.title: LORD OF MAINNET
cards.concept: ascended bareheaded builder with his short swept-up hair showing and his huge beaming grin, in gold and white chrome regalia with a high collar, a crown of glowing golden GPU cores orbiting high above his head, cyan circuit lines on the armour and a radiant golden data aura around his silhouette
cards.hook: Founding engineer of on-chain compute, crowned by the GPUs his chain brings to life.
